verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for an AI email client, but the pack has no documentation of retention settings, data-deletion requests, or controls over how long Superhuman or its AI keeps user data. The only related mentions are inbox actions, such as bulk-trashing messages from a sender (comm-17) and Auto Archive. These are adjacent email-management features, not privacy-posture retention controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
